object.description: On the clean machine, download the Windows installer and SHA256SUMS.txt from the published release and compute the installer's SHA-256 with Get-FileHash. Expected: SHA256SUMS.txt is attached to the release and lists the installer's file name with a checksum equal to the computed one.
